title: An explicit induced-edge completion earns exact canonical trace insertion/reassembly
statement: Use T_plus(s)=G[V(T(s))], the ambient induced graph on the already charged vertices of the old full trace. Add every edge between those vertices, with no new gate, vertex or branch decision. A polymer is a connected canonical labeled T_plus(tau) for a valid nonzero syndrome; compatibility means disjoint vertices and no ambient edge between them. The actual fixed-input-seeded/all-potential-stencil/all-branch decoder replay gives T_plus(component leaves)=component, exact reverse assembly and correction additivity. All valid syndromes therefore biject compatible polymers. The old removable-witness injection or abstract F1–F4 conditions alone did not prove insertion. Cancelled prepass gates and complete owner/operand stencils are essential. Space-scale charge, degree and entropy bounds remain, without a claim of Euclidean-distance clustering. This new combinatorial representation alone does not establish a perturbed quantum gas.
